# Data
Read in data
```{r}
# ## Population of Mérida + Kanasín (old)
yuc_pop <- read.csv("data/SINAVE_Data/RESAGEBURB2020 - 31 Yucatán.csv")

merida_pop <- read.csv("data/yuc_pop/yuc_pop_all.csv") %>% # all of yucatan
  filter(MUN == 50 | MUN == 41 | MUN == 101) # only metro merida

## Mérida + Kanasín shapefile from INEGI (eem - Block Polygons)
merida_block_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("31_yucatan_2020/conjunto_de_datos"),
                    layer = "31m")
merida_block_sf <- merida_block_sf %>% 
  filter(CVE_MUN == "041" | CVE_MUN == "050" | CVE_MUN == "100")

## Mérida + Kanasín shapefile from INEGI (eea - Basic Urban Geostatistical Areas)
merida_cluster_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("31_yucatan_2020/conjunto_de_datos"),
                    layer = "31a")
merida_cluster_sf <- merida_cluster_sf %>% 
  filter(CVE_MUN == "041" | CVE_MUN == "050")

## SINAVE case data
sinave_all_cases <- here::here("data", "SINAVE_Data", 
                       "datos_abiertos_dengue_061223.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

## Cases Shapefile
cases_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"), 
                 layer = "TIRS_SINAVE_22_23")

## Cases by TIRS block (not a shapefile, will add this info onto the shapefile)
cases_tirs_info <- read_csv("data/TIRS_SINAVE_combined22_23_blockID.csv")


## TIRS Clusters Shapefile
clusters_sf <- st_read(dsn = here("data"),
                    layer = "Cluster final 2021 actualizado")

## entomological data
ento <- here::here("data", "TIRS_database_entom_summ.csv") %>%
  rio::import() %>% 
  dplyr::as_tibble()

# make sure all sf files have the same coordinates 
merida_cluster_sf <- st_transform(merida_cluster_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
cases_sf <- st_transform(cases_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
clusters_sf <- st_transform(clusters_sf, st_crs(merida_block_sf))
```

Formatting the data for the model
```{r}
all <- cases_tirs_info %>% 
  #head(7) %>% 
  mutate(id = 1:833,
         block_id = ifelse(is.na(MZTIRS), CVE_MZA, MZTIRS),
         cluster_id = CLUSTER,
         week_onset = Week_onset) %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, block_id, cluster_id, Week_onset, week_onset)
v <- c(rep(-1, 9), rep(-1, 3), 1)
neg_vax <- as.data.frame(matrix(v, nrow = 833, ncol = length(v), byrow = TRUE))
all <- cbind(all, neg_vax)
all <- all %>% 
  mutate(vax_date = week_onset - 1) %>% 
  dplyr::select(id, block_id, cluster_id, Week_onset, week_onset, 
                V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, vax_date, 
                V11, V12, V13)
write.table(all, file = "all.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

inf_time <- all$Week_onset
inf_times <- matrix(inf_time, nrow = 100, ncol = length(inf_time), 
                    byrow = TRUE)
write.table(inf_times, file = "inf_times.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

# attendance
house_attend <- c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1)
house_attend <- matrix(house_attend, nrow = 7, ncol = 52)
write.table(house_attend, file = "house_attend.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

attend_school <- c(1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1)
attend_school <- matrix(attend_school, nrow = 7, ncol = 52)
write.table(attend_school, file = "attend_school.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

attend_comm <- c(1, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1)
attend_comm <- matrix(attend_comm, nrow = 833, ncol = 52)
write.table(attend_comm, file = "attend_comm.txt", sep = " ", row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE)

attend_hyponeg <- matrix(1, nrow = 50, ncol = 52)
write.table(attend_hyponeg, file = "attend_hyponeg.txt", sep = " ",
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```

# Graphs
## MCMC chains
```{r}
here()
mcmc_chains <- read.table(
  here("model_output", "mcmc_chains", "mcmc.alpha-s1.txt"), 
  sep=" ", 
  header = TRUE)
mcmc_chains <- mcmc_chains %>% 
  mutate(iter = row_number())
mcmc_long <- mcmc_chains %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(alpha, gamma, Gta, Gtb, nSim, logL, nAccept),
               names_to = "fitted_var",
               values_to = "value") 

plot_trace_density <- function(variable, colour = "#2C3E50") {
  trace <- ggplot(filter(mcmc_long, fitted_var == variable),
                  aes(x = iter, y = value)) +
    geom_line(colour = colour, alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = variable,
         x = NULL,
         y = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  dens <- ggplot(filter(mcmc_long, fitted_var == variable),
                 aes(x = value)) +
    geom_density(fill = colour, alpha = 0.25, colour = "NA") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(y = NULL,
         x = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  grid.arrange(trace, dens, nrow = 2, heights = c(2, 1))
}

plot_trace_density("alpha")
```
